title: Spain Stun France 2-0 to Reach FIFA World Cup Final
byline: Goals from Mikel Oyarzabal and Pedro Porro earned Spain a deserved 2-0 win over France at Dallas Stadium in their FIFA World Cup 2026 semi-final

title: Public urged to responsibly feed and care for stray dogs
byline: Director General of the Department of Animal Production and Health (DAPH), Dr. Sanjika Perera, has urged the public to continue feeding stray dogs but also take responsibility for their health and welfare.

title: Adani Group fastest to enter India’s top 10 most valuable brands: Report
byline: The Adani Group has become the fastest brand to enter India’s ’Top 10 Most Valuable Brands’ for the first time, while Adani Power became the country’s top energy brand in the ’Brand Finance India 100 Report 2026’, it was announced on Tuesday.

title: Prison population surges to over 42,000 following ’Ratama Ekata’ operation
byline: Sri Lanka’s prison population has increased from around 28,000 inmates to more than 42,000 since the government took office in 2024, largely due to intensified anti-drug operations ’ Ratama Ekata’, Cabinet Spokesman and Minister Nalinda Jayatissa said.

title: Midnight social media curfew proposed for older UK teens
byline: Older teenagers in the UK will face an overnight social media curfew, the government has announced - though they will be able to opt out of it by changing their account settings.

title: Trump threatens to bomb bridges and power plants unless Iran resumes talks
byline: US President Donald Trump threatened to strike Iran’s bridges and power plants next week if it did not return to talks.

title: Environment agency demands for higher charge on plastic bags
byline: The Sri Lanka Environmental Action Network (SLEAN) has urged the Central Environmental Authority (CEA) to strengthen enforcement of the plastic shopping bag charge, saying inconsistent implementation by supermarkets, retail stores and small businesses is undermining the policy’s effectiveness.

title: Sri Lanka to launch South Asia’s first passenger drone service
byline: The Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka (CAASL) is preparing to launch a pilot project to introduce passenger-carrying drones, marking what is expected to be the first initiative of its kind in South Asia as the country moves towards adopting advanced air mobility (AAM) solutions.

title: Sri Lankan politicians have longer lifespans, study finds
byline: A recent study conducted in India has found that doctors in Asian countries such as Sri Lanka have a shorter life expectancy than other professionals, while people involved in mainstream politics in Sri Lanka often live well beyond the age of 65, Doctors’ Trade Union Alliance for Medical and Civil Rights Chairman Specialist Dr. Chamal Sanjeewa claimed.

title: PM leaves for Doha to attend Qatar Emir’s funeral
byline: Prime Minister Harini Amarasuriya left Sri Lanka for Doha, Qatar, last night (July 14) to attend the funeral of the Emir of Qatar.

title: Special train services to Jaffna for Nallur Festival – Minister Bimal Rathnayake assures
byline: Minister of Highways and Transport Bimal Rathnayake has assured that the government is paying attention to providing special train and bus services during the Nallur and Madhu festival seasons, two of the most significant religious festivals in Northern Sri Lanka.

title: Road accident in Anuradhapura kills two, injures pregnant woman
byline: Two people were killed and a pregnant woman was seriously injured following a collision between a motorcycle and a “Sisu Seriya” school bus in the Mihindupura area of Anuradhapura this morning (15), police said.

title: Excavation at Chemmani mass grave resumes today
byline: The third segment of the third phase of excavation at the Chemmani mass grave in Jaffna resumed on Wednesday morning.

title: Central Province Governor Sarath Abeykoon resigns
byline: Central Province Governor Prof. Sarath Abeykoon has tendered his letter of resignation from the post of Governor to President Anura Kumara Dissanayake, citing personal reasons.

title: Walk with an Elephant’ launched at Pinnawala
byline: Visitors to the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage can now take part in a unique ’’Walk with an Elephant’’ experience, offering an opportunity to observe the animals up close while learning about elephant conservation.

title: BIA handles 4.7 million passengers in first half of 2026
byline: Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) handled more than 4.7 million passenger movements during the first six months of 2026, highlighting continued growth in Sri Lanka’s aviation and tourism sectors.

title: Cuba plunged into third nationwide blackout in two weeks as power grid collapses
byline: Cuba suffered another blackout of the National Electric System, or SEN, on Tuesday, leaving the entire island country without power, officials said, in what was the third such incident in less than two weeks as a US oil embargo stresses the island’s grid.

title: AKD gains 75.5% public satisfaction against Sajith’s 29.4%
byline: Public satisfaction with President Anura Kumara Dissanayake stands at 75.5%, significantly higher than the 29.4% satisfaction rating recorded by Opposition Leader Sajith Premadasa, according to the latest Confidence in Democratic Governance Index released by the Centre for Policy Alternatives (CPA) Social Indicator.

title: Former minister’s brother arrested over fraud
byline: Former Provincial Councillor Jayalath Bandara Dissanayake, the brother of former Minister S.B. Dissanayake, has been arrested over allegations of financial fraud, according to police.

title: Dengue deaths near 50 as cases top 71,000
byline: Sri Lanka’s dengue death toll has climbed to nearly 50, while the total number of reported infections has surpassed 71,000 so far this year, according to the National Dengue Control Unit (NDCU).

title: Super El Niño probability rises to 81%
byline: The U.S. National Weather Service (NWS) has raised the probability of the current El Niño developing into a Super El Niño to 81%. According to the latest outlook, there is a 97% chance that the climate pattern will persist at least until early spring 2027. If warming in the Pacific Ocean continues, this event could become one of the strongest recorded since the mid-20th century.

title: Gold prices ease globally, rupee depreciation limits fall in Sri Lanka
byline: Gold prices have declined in international markets, with the downward trend also being reflected in Sri Lanka, although the depreciation of the rupee against the US dollar has limited the impact of the decline on local prices, according to the Sri Lanka Gem and Jewellery Association (SLGJA).

title: Showers expected in several provinces, strong winds forecast in several areas
byline: The Meteorological Department has forecast a few showers in the Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-Western provinces, as well as in the Kandy, Nuwara Eliya, Galle and Matara districts during the next 36 hours.

title: UNP-SJB unity needed to build strong opposition: Naveen Dissanayake
byline: United National Party (UNP) National Organizer Naveen Dissanayake said that forming a strong opposition through cooperation between the UNP and the Samagi Jana Balawegaya (SJB) is the need of the present era.

title: Supreme Court fixes October 30 to hear FR petition over Ditwah response failure
byline: A Fundamental Rights petition filed by a lawyer practicing and residing in Kandy, alleging failures by the President, the Cabinet of Ministers and several state authorities to take timely and coordinated action to mitigate the impact of cyclonic storm “Ditwah,” despite having prior notice of the impending disaster, was today fixed for support on October 30 by the Supreme Court.

title: Cardinal to file legal action against MP Chamara Sampath
byline: Archbishop of Colombo Cardinal Malcolm Ranjith is to file legal action against MP Chamara Sampath Dassanayake for making false statements, Cardinal’s spokesman Fr. Cyril Gamini Fernando said today.

title: World Cup Final Week: Rivalries, Records and Glory Await
byline: The FIFA World Cup 2026 has reached its dramatic climax, with England and Argentina preparing for a blockbuster semi-final showdown as football’s biggest stars chase history. From Lionel Messi’s Golden Boot battle to Harry Kane and Jude Bellingham’s World Cup dreams, the final week promises unforgettable moments, legendary performances and a spectacular celebration of the beautiful game.

title: Y-12 aircraft hit by kite string; SLAF warns against flying kites near airports
byline: The Sri Lanka Air Force (SLAF) has urged the public to avoid flying kites near airports and runways after a Y-12 aircraft was forced to make an emergency return landing following a kite string-related safety incident during a training mission from Ratmalana Airport.

title: South Asia’s longest irrigation tunnel completed under North Central Canal project
byline: Excavation work on South Asia’s longest irrigation tunnel, stretching 27.7 kilometres, was officially completed today (15) under the North Central Canal Project.

title: ICC explores 12-team ODI World Cup, WTC semi-finals and global franchise T20 event
byline: The International Cricket Council (ICC) held its annual conference in Edinburgh last week, where senior officials discussed several key proposals that could shape the future of international cricket. With new broadcast rights negotiations on the horizon, the governing body explored possible changes to global tournaments, the international calendar, and the game’s formats to enhance both competitiveness and commercial value.

title: SriLankan aircraft circle Middle East skies for over an hour due to airspace closures
byline: Two SriLankan Airlines aircraft were forced to circle over the Middle East for more than an hour after Kuwait and Saudi Arabia temporarily closed their airspaces following a sudden military escalation in the region, SriLankan Airlines Head of Corporate Communications Deepal Perera said.

title: World Cup fans left stunned by price of FIFA hospitality package for Sunday’s final
byline: Spain booked their spot in the final on Tuesday after defeating France, with England and Argentina set to battle it out for their spot on Wednesday.

title: Govt steps up action on Ratnapura land, elephant conflict
byline: The government has pledged to expedite solutions to long-standing land issues in the Kalthota and Weligepola divisions of Ratnapura District while introducing new measures to reduce human-elephant conflict in the area.

title: Sri Lanka begins talks on strengthening digital workforce and institutions
byline: Sri Lanka has launched discussions with international development partners to strengthen the country’s digital transformation by focusing on human resources and institutional capacity alongside technology.

title: Sri Lankans get chance to win  Messi, Ronaldo jerseys
byline: Sri Lankan football fans now have an unprecedented opportunity to own memorabilia signed by two of the greatest footballers of all time, as Ritzbury Roccoa launched a nationwide promotional campaign featuring what they claim are

title: Cuba plunged into third nationwide blackout in two weeks as power grid collapses
byline: Cuba suffered another blackout of the National Electric System, or SEN, on Tuesday, leaving the entire island country without power, officials said, in what was the third such incident in less than two weeks as a US oil embargo stresses the island’s grid.

title: Midnight social media curfew proposed for older UK teens
byline: Older teenagers in the UK will face an overnight social media curfew, the government has announced - though they will be able to opt out of it by changing their account settings.

title: Trump threatens to bomb bridges and power plants unless Iran resumes talks
byline: US President Donald Trump threatened to strike Iran’s bridges and power plants next week if it did not return to talks.

title: Sri Lankan-run dealership convicted in New Zealand’s first odometer tampering case: The Press
byline: A Sri Lankan-operated used car dealership in New Zealand has been convicted in what The Press, a Christchurch-based daily newspaper and news website, reported is the country’s first successful prosecution for odometer tampering under the Motor Vehicle Sales Act.

title: NPP’s Negombo Mayor resigns
byline: The Mayor of the Negombo Municipal Council, Attorney-at-Law Robert Heenkenda, announced this afternoon that he is resigning from the post.

title: PM Harini meets Qatar Emir, conveys Sri Lanka’s condolences
byline: Prime Minister Dr. Harini Amarasuriya met with the Emir of the State of Qatar, His Highness Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani, during her visit to Doha to convey Sri Lanka’s condolences on the passing of the Father Amir.

title: Environment Ministry to fill vacancies in 10 institutions to boost public service efficiency
byline: The Environment Ministry today announced steps to expedite the recruitment of employees to fill vacancies across institutions under its purview, with the aim of improving productivity and strengthening public service delivery.

title: President instructs officials to develop Delft, Analaitivu, Nainativu as green energy islands
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake has instructed officials of the Ministry of Energy to focus on developing and promoting islands of Delft, Analaitivu and Nainativu as Green Energy Islands.

title: New Men’s T20 World Cup format and qualification explained
byline: The ICC Men’s T20 World Cup will continue to provide a platform for cricket’s emerging nations to compete on the global stage, following encouraging performances from developing teams at the recently-concluded 2026 tournament.

title: Private O/L candidates without NICs can apply using guardian’s NIC
byline: The Department of Examinations said that private candidates sitting for the 2026 G.C.E. (Ordinary Level) Examination who have not yet obtained a National Identity Card (NIC) may apply for the examination using their guardian’s NIC number.

title: ICC calls for early Sri Lanka Cricket elections: Keeps SLC out of board meetings
byline: The International Cricket Council (ICC) Board has reiterated its call for Sri Lanka Cricket (SLC) to hold elections as soon as possible, while noting progress towards adopting a revised constitution during its Annual Meetings in Edinburgh.

title: Not hesitant to work for the country, if invited: Mahinda Samarasinghe
byline: Claiming that the government never called him back, outgoing Ambassador of Sri Lanka to the United States Mahinda Samarasinghe said he is not hesitant to render his service for the country, if the government invited him.

title: Katunayake police officer shot; drug suspect escapes
byline: A police officer was admitted to the Negombo Hospital after being shot during an incident in the Gamamottawa area of Katunayake this afternoon (15), after an arrested drug suspect allegedly snatched the officer’s service firearm and escaped.
